title: [spec-gap][R-04-020/023] Hop-aware broadcast relay limiter absent in Rust+C; Python divergent and unwired (spec 04 6.3.3)
description:
Spec spec/04-network.md 6.3.3 (MUST-level relay decision): per-sender relay state keyed on full primary /128, hop_bucket[1-7] per-bucket counters with budgets 200/100/30/10 (hl 8..255 clamped to bucket 7, bucket=min(hl,7)), separate sos_count (budget 3/hr across all hops) detected via L2 dispatch 0x16, drop at count>=budget, 50% probabilistic drop at count>=budget*0.5, state expiry after 2h idle.

Evidence:
- Rust: no broadcast relay limiter anywhere (rg hop_bucket|sos_count|BroadcastRateLimiter over rust/ = only DIO rate-limit router.rs:366 and SOS-rate-limit lichen-link/src/sos.rs which are different mechanisms).
- C: no broadcast relay limiter (lichen/subsys has only DIO/SOS/LOADng rate limits).
- Python: python/src/lichen/link/broadcast_limit.py implements budgets 200/100/30/10 (lines 24-47), yellow zone 50% drop (classify_broadcast), 2h idle expiry (SENDER_STATE_IDLE_S=7200) — but: (a) one shared rolling window per sender instead of per-hop_bucket counters (BroadcastRateLimiter.admit keys classify_broadcast on len(stamps) across ALL hop limits), (b) no sos_count / no L2 dispatch 0x16 detection, (c) broadcast_budget raises ValueError for hl outside [1,7] instead of clamping 8..255 to bucket 7, (d) keyed on sender_iid str not the full 128-bit primary /128 (same root cause as existing bead project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.124), (e) limiter is referenced only by python/tests/link/test_broadcast_limit_vectors.py — never wired into any node relay path.

Relay decision MUST (drop at budget, yellow-zone 50%, counter increment, HL decrement, rebroadcast) therefore has no end-to-end implementation in any stack. SOS budget/detection rows are separately tracked by b7z9.110 (SOS dispatch 0x16 not consumed end-to-end) and b7z9.120 (no 0x16 emitter).

Test vectors exist and pass for the Python unit (test/vectors/broadcast_rate_limiting.json).

Suggested placement: Rust lichen-node routing/router.rs + C lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c (both already own multicast relay decisions); wire Python BroadcastRateLimiter into lichen Node RX relay path. Fix keying together with b7z9.124.
